subject: Quantix - provisional dedicated sizing & contingency hold request
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quantix - provisional dedicated sizing & contingency hold request

Team —

Quantix (Elaine Park, ops + procurement looped) is in final commercial negotiations for a Dedicated deployment. They are asking that we provision a provisional capacity window so they can complete legal/PO activity without losing slot availability. High-level ask from product/ops at the customer:

- Target go-live: 2027-01-10
- Steady-state: 6x A100 80GB-equivalent for inference (sustained throughput target ~1.2k tokens/sec, 99th latency target <120ms for typical single-turn chat workloads)
- Burst: up to 4x H100-class (for nightly batch scoring spikes)
- Minimum commitment window requested: 6 months

Attached is their SLA/requirements spreadsheet for quick reference. Can infra confirm:
1) Current inventory by region (us-west1/us-east1) for A100-80GB and H100-class capacity.
2) Whether we can place a 14–30 day provisional "soft hold" that prevents other sales from committing (what do we require from the customer to hold?).
3) Recommended firm-hold conversion terms (prepay %, lead time to flip to hard reserve, cancellation penalties).
4) Any fallback model mixes (e.g., A100 + mixed quantized instances) that meet latency SLOs while reducing footprint/cost.

I need a short ops summary within 24 hours — Quantix wants to confirm the hold today so they can align internal approvals. If we can only do a shorter soft-hold, flag it and we will push for a faster PO.

Thanks —
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Quantix_SLA_requirements_v1.pdf]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Quantix - provisional dedicated sizing & contingency hold request

Priyom —

Inventory snapshot (quick):
- us-west1: 14 x A100-80GB available immediately, 6 x H100-class available for burst (region pool).
- us-east1: 6 x A100-80GB (some in use but can be freed within 7–10 days), 2 x H100-class (limited).

Notes & recommendation:
1) Soft-hold policy we can implement: create a provisional reservation that marks N units as "soft-reserved" for up to 21 days. Soft-reserved units are still visible to other teams but require an extra approval to reassign; to convert to a firm hold we require a signed SOW + 25% prepayment.
2) For Quantix's ask (6 A100-80GB + 4 H100 burst): propose to soft-reserve 6 A100-80GB equivalents in us-west1 for 21 days and enable H100 burst via policy gating (autoscale to H100 when CPU/memory thresholds hit). If they need firm capacity earlier, escalation path requires finance/ops confirmation of deposit.
3) Fallback option: recommend a 4 A100-80GB + 4 x q4_8 quantized A100-variants mix — expected to meet 95% of traffic with small tail latency degradation; reduces firm-hold footprint by ~20% and eases immediate capacity pressure. We'll need to run a quick perf check with representative prompt set (can be done within 48 hours).

Operational steps to implement soft hold:
- Create capacity hold record in INF system (I opened ticket INF-3198).
- Tag instances in us-west1 pool and flag for 21-day soft-reserve.
- Advise sales on conversion terms and share DocuSign link for provisional commitment (we only flip to hard hold after SOW + deposit).

I've attached the fleet snapshot for your records. If you want me to place the soft-reserve now, confirm with the customer's contact details and the required hold window (14 vs 21 days).

—Monica
Monica Patel
Capacity Ops Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: fleet_snapshot_20261123.csv]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@quantix.ai>, Procurement <procurement@quantix.ai>, ops+cloud@quantix.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 14:32:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Finalize Dedicated Sizing — provisional hold confirmed

Elaine / Quantix team —

Thanks for the quick alignment on requirements. We can provision a provisional capacity window while you close internal procurement. Summary of what we can hold now:

- Provisional soft-reserve: 6 x A100-80GB equivalents in us-west1 for 21 days (soft-reserve prevents normal auto-assignment but can be escalated by Capacity Ops with approval).
- H100-class burst: Available for autoscale, subject to burst approval at time of spike.
- Conversion to firm hold: requires signed SOW + 25% prepayment (then we convert to hard reserve and de-prioritize other allocations).

Next steps we need from Quantix:
1) Confirm you want the 21-day provisional soft-reserve window (or request 14 days).
2) Sign the provisional commitment (DocuSign link below) so we can begin the reservation flow and capture billing info.
3) Share final expected peak window (if there are known batch scoring dates) so we can schedule capacity ramp.

DocuSign (provisional commitment): https://docusign.com/link/to/provisional-commit/QTX-119
I've attached the customer requirements file you shared for our records. Once you confirm the hold length we'll have Monica finalize the soft-reserve in INF and I'll follow up with a timeline to convert to a firm hold.

Best,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Quantix_CTR_Reqs.xlsx]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

All —

Confirmed: Monica has created ticket INF-3198 and placed a 21-day soft-reserve against 6 A100-80GB equivalents in us-west1. Monica, please update the ticket with the reservation ID and add an explicit expiration timestamp once it's generated.

Sales ops note: Per policy, we require a signed SOW + 25% prepay to flip to a firm hold. Priyom — loop finance for the invoice and confirm the DocuSign link is charged to the Quantix procurement email.

If any region constraints change (e.g., Quantix asks to move to us-east1), escalate immediately — that pool is tight in December. Marcus / Neha: coordinate the perf validation (48-hour smoke) if Quantix agrees to the fallback mix.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
